title: Aspire Launches Aspire Account-Opening Integration With Osome
summary: Aspire and Osome partner to enable faster Business Account opening
body_markdown:
# With this integration, founders can open an Aspire business account directly from the Osome app without re-entering company or founder information. This saves the hassle of separately linking an Aspire account to Osome, as it now happens automatically, with approval status tracked right from the app.


# “Founders do not want more financial products. They want fewer places where they have to explain their business. An Aspire account now opens from inside Osome without re-entering company details, and bookkeeping starts automatically the moment it is live. Aspire has been our banking partner for years, and this is the first time a founder can get through both steps without noticing there were two,’ says Eugenio Ferrante, CEO of Osome.


Banking set-up is one of the most tedious and long-drawn processes when setting up a company, and one that creates a lot of anxiety for founders who are chasing deadlines. The integration with Osome removes the duplication of data entry when creating a bank account with Aspire, and bookkeeping starts automatically from thereon. Tax filing is done on time and becomes less stressful, giving founders their peace of mind and precious time back.


# “Founders already have enough complexity to deal with when starting and growing a company. Opening a business account shouldn’t add to it. With Osome, we’re removing one of those unnecessary hurdles: founders can incorporate their company and open an Aspire account without submitting the same information twice. It’s a simple change, but one that makes the journey from setting up a company to actually running it much smoother,” says Andrea Baronchelli, Co-Founder and CEO of Aspire.
